Method Overriding for Rectangle Area

Problem Statement:
Write a program that demonstrates inheritance and method overriding in Java. A superclass Shape contains a method area(), and the subclass Rectangle overrides the method. 
Input Description:
Two integers representing the length and breadth of the rectangle. 
Output Description:
Area of the rectangle. 
Sample Input:
10 5 
Sample Output:
50.0
